HOME — SERVICES

12+

Years of
Experience

Serving Southern Ontario since 2012. We are known for quality detectors in the Hamilton and Niagara region.

🏕️

Valuable Recovery
(Lost & Found)

Lost a wedding band, jewelry, or keys? We offer professional metal detecting recovery services. We can search yards, parks, beaches, and shallow water (wading depth—no deep scuba diving required). Let us help reunite you with your lost keepsakes.

🎯

Expert Equipment
Matchmaking

As an authorized dealer for Minelab, Nokta, and Garrett, we don't just sell boxes. Tell us how you want to hunt, and we will match you with the perfect machine for the Southern Ontario terrain.

🧭

Beginner Training &
Orientation

New to the hobby? We offer basic orientation with your purchase. We will show you how to properly swing, understand tones, and dig clean plugs so you can start finding treasure immediately.
